Every entry is one piece of work. Where a preprint became a paper, both are linked so the progression is visible. Papers with a short summary can be expanded. The list is built from my [ORCID record](https://orcid.org/{{< var orcid >}}). Data and code releases are listed separately at the end.

```{r}
#| label: publications-list
#| results: asis

# Data loading and the entry helpers are shared with the programme pages.
source(here::here("scripts", "paper_cards.R"))

# DOIs set to `hide` in the overrides file. update_publications.R drops them on
# its next run; filtering here as well keeps the page right in the meantime.
hidden <- read_csv(here::here("data", "publications_overrides.csv"), col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                   show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(action %in% "hide") |>
  pull(doi) |>
  str_to_lower()

# Topic tags for the filter, one row per paper, in data/publication_topics.csv.
topic_tags <- read_csv(here::here("data", "publication_topics.csv"), col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                   show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(doi = str_to_lower(doi), topics = str_replace_all(topics, ";", " "))

topic_labels <- c(lassa = "Lassa fever", arha = "Arenaviruses and hantaviruses", `rodent-ecology` = "Rodent ecology",
                  surveillance = "Surveillance and outbreaks", covid = "COVID-19", mpox = "mpox",
                  vaccines = "Vaccines and trials", tools = "Tools and data",
                  `digital-health` = "Digital health and smoking", other = "Other")
role_labels <- c(first = "First author", last = "Last author")
status_labels <- c(published = "Published", preprint = "Preprint only")

# ---- papers -----------------------------------------------------------------

# Numbered newest-highest, so a paper keeps its number as new ones arrive.
# Authorship is read from the full author list: first and last position.
papers <- pubs |>
  filter(kind %in% c("article", "preprint"), !str_to_lower(doi) %in% hidden) |>
  mutate(year_n = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year))) |>
  arrange(desc(year_n), title) |>
  mutate(n = rev(seq_len(n())),
         doi_key = str_to_lower(doi)) |>
  left_join(topic_tags, by = c("doi_key" = "doi")) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(role = {
    a <- str_trim(str_split(authors, ",")[[1]])
    paste(c(if (identical(a[1], "Simons D")) "first", if (length(a) > 1 && identical(a[length(a)], "Simons D")) "last"), collapse = " ")
  }) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(status = if_else(kind == "preprint", "preprint", "published"),
         topics = coalesce(topics, "other"))

untagged <- papers |> filter(!doi_key %in% topic_tags$doi)
if (nrow(untagged)) message("Papers without topic tags (shown as Other): ", paste(untagged$doi, collapse = ", "))

# The filter panel. Counts are over all papers; the script narrows the list.
option_html <- function(group, labels, values) {
  counts <- vapply(names(labels), function(k) sum(str_detect(values, paste0("(^| )", k, "( |$)"))), integer(1))
  keep <- counts > 0
  paste(sprintf('<label><input type="checkbox" name="%s" value="%s"> <span>%s</span> <span class="pf-count">%d</span></label>',
                group, names(labels)[keep], labels[keep], counts[keep]), collapse = "\n")
}
cat("::: {.pubs-filter-col}\n\n```{=html}\n")
cat('<details class="pub-filters">\n<summary>Filter papers</summary>\n<form class="pf-form" aria-label="Filter papers">\n')
cat('<fieldset><legend>Topic</legend>\n', option_html("topic", topic_labels, papers$topics), '\n</fieldset>\n')
cat('<fieldset><legend>Authorship</legend>\n', option_html("role", role_labels, papers$role), '\n</fieldset>\n')
cat('<fieldset><legend>Status</legend>\n', option_html("status", status_labels, papers$status), '\n</fieldset>\n')
cat('</form>\n</details>\n```\n\n:::\n\n')
cat('```{=html}\n<div class="pf-status" aria-live="polite"><span class="pf-shown"></span><span class="pf-chips"></span></div>\n```\n\n')

for (y in unique(papers$year_n)) {
  heading <- if (is.na(y)) "Undated {#year-undated}" else sprintf("%d {#year-%d}", y, y)
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", heading))
  block <- papers |> filter(if (is.na(y)) is.na(year_n) else year_n == y)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(block))) {
    attrs <- sprintf('data-topics="%s" data-role="%s" data-status="%s"', block$topics[i], block$role[i], block$status[i])
    render_entry(block[i, ], block$n[i], attrs = attrs)
  }
}

# ---- data and code ----------------------------------------------------------

# A Zenodo record has a concept DOI (all versions) and one DOI per version, and
# ORCID can list both. Show one entry per title: the newest version, with a
# link to all versions when the concept DOI is also present.
datasets <- pubs |>
  filter(kind %in% c("data", "software"), !str_to_lower(doi) %in% hidden) |>
  mutate(year_n = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)),
         doi_n = suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(doi, "\\d+$")))) |>
  arrange(title, desc(doi_n)) |>
  summarise(kind = first(kind), year = first(year), year_n = first(year_n), authors = first(authors),
            url = first(url), all_versions = if (n() > 1) last(url) else NA_character_, id = first(id),
            .by = title) |>
  arrange(desc(year_n), title)

if (nrow(datasets)) {
  cat("## Data and code {#data-and-code}\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(datasets))) {
    row <- datasets[i, ]
    label <- if (row$kind == "software") "Software" else "Dataset"
    cat(sprintf("::: {.pub-entry .pub-entry-plain .pub-data #pub-%s}\n::: {.pub-body}\n", row$id))
    cat(sprintf("**%s**  \n", row$title))
    auth <- format_authors(row$authors)
    if (auth != "") cat(auth, "  \n", sep = "")
    links <- sprintf("[%s, %s](%s)", label, row$year, row$url)
    if (!is.na(row$all_versions)) links <- paste0(links, sprintf(" · [All versions](%s)", row$all_versions))
    cat(links, "\n:::\n:::\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  // ---- Year ladder ---------------------------------------------------------
  // One rung per visible paper beside each year in the sidebar. The count is
  // in the link's label for screen readers; the rungs are decoration.
  // Quarto rewrites the sidebar link addresses after load, so match on the
  // fragment rather than the whole href.
  const updateLadder = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('#TOC a[href*="#year-"]').forEach(link => {
      const section = document.getElementById(link.getAttribute("href").split("#")[1]);
      if (!section) return;
      const n = section.querySelectorAll(".pub-entry:not([hidden])").length;
      if (!link.dataset.year) link.dataset.year = link.textContent.trim();
      link.replaceChildren();
      const rungs = document.createElement("span");
      rungs.className = "year-rungs";
      rungs.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) rungs.append(document.createElement("i"));
      const count = document.createElement("span");
      count.className = "year-count";
      count.textContent = n;
      link.append(rungs, document.createTextNode(link.dataset.year), count);
      link.setAttribute("aria-label", `${link.dataset.year}, ${n} ${n === 1 ? "paper" : "papers"}`);
      const item = link.closest("li");
      item?.classList.add("year-rung-item");
      if (item) item.hidden = n === 0;
    });
    document.querySelector("#TOC")?.classList.add("year-ladder");
  };

  // ---- Filters -------------------------------------------------------------
  // Within a group any ticked option matches; across groups all must match.
  // Without JavaScript the panel is inert and the full list shows.
  const form = document.querySelector(".pf-form");
  const details = document.querySelector(".pub-filters");
  const entries = [...document.querySelectorAll(".pub-entry[data-topics]")];
  const groups = { topic: "topics", role: "role", status: "status" };
  const shown = document.querySelector(".pf-shown");
  const chips = document.querySelector(".pf-chips");

  const selected = () => Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(groups).map(g =>
    [g, [...form.querySelectorAll(`input[name="${g}"]:checked`)].map(i => i.value)]));

  const apply = () => {
    const sel = selected();
    let visible = 0;
    entries.forEach(e => {
      const ok = Object.entries(groups).every(([g, attr]) => {
        if (!sel[g].length) return true;
        const tags = (e.dataset[attr] || "").split(/\s+/);
        return sel[g].some(v => tags.includes(v));
      });
      e.hidden = !ok;
      if (ok) visible++;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('section[id^="year-"]').forEach(s => {
      s.hidden = !s.querySelector(".pub-entry:not([hidden])");
    });
    const active = Object.values(sel).some(v => v.length);
    shown.textContent = active ? `Showing ${visible} of ${entries.length} papers` : `${entries.length} papers`;
    chips.replaceChildren();
    if (active) {
      form.querySelectorAll("input:checked").forEach(input => {
        const chip = document.createElement("button");
        chip.type = "button";
        chip.className = "pf-chip";
        chip.textContent = input.parentElement.querySelector("span").textContent;
        chip.setAttribute("aria-label", `Remove filter: ${chip.textContent}`);
        chip.addEventListener("click", () => { input.checked = false; apply(); });
        chips.append(chip);
      });
      const clear = document.createElement("button");
      clear.type = "button";
      clear.className = "pf-clear";
      clear.textContent = "Clear";
      clear.addEventListener("click", () => { form.reset(); apply(); });
      chips.append(clear);
    }
    // Keep the filters in the address, so a filtered list can be shared.
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    Object.entries(sel).forEach(([g, v]) => { if (v.length) params.set(g, v.join(",")); });
    const query = params.toString();
    history.replaceState(null, "", query ? `?${query}${location.hash}` : location.pathname + location.hash);
    updateLadder();
  };

  const init = () => {
    if (!form) { updateLadder(); return; }
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    Object.keys(groups).forEach(g => (params.get(g) || "").split(",").filter(Boolean).forEach(v => {
      const input = form.querySelector(`input[name="${g}"][value="${v}"]`);
      if (input) input.checked = true;
    }));
    // Open beside the list on wide screens; a closed button above it on narrow ones.
    const wide = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1200px)");
    // On wide screens the panel's column starts level with the list.
    const col = document.querySelector(".pubs-filter-col");
    const status = document.querySelector(".pf-status");
    const setOpen = () => {
      details.open = wide.matches;
      if (col && status) col.style.setProperty("--pf-top", `${status.offsetTop}px`);
    };
    setOpen();
    wide.addEventListener("change", setOpen);
    window.addEventListener("resize", setOpen);
    form.addEventListener("change", apply);
    apply();
  };
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init); else init();
})();
</script>
```
